description:
Replace literal well-known `.jit` file names in storage, configuration and declaration loaders with `VirtualPath` constants.

## Background

`VirtualPath` declares well-known data-root files through `declare_well_known_paths!` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:259-310`), and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve` (`path.rs:530`). Literals remain in `storage/user_config_store.rs`, `storage/discovery.rs`, `storage/json.rs`, `storage/ruleset_store.rs`, `storage/gate_store.rs`, `config.rs`, `declarations/invariants.rs`, `templates.rs`, `profile/template_region.rs`, `validation/repository.rs` and `main.rs`. `gate_presets/manager.rs:25,95` joins `config/gate-presets` from literals, and `storage/memory.rs:361` matches the `gate-runs` segment as a literal.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No string literal in the listed files, `gate_presets/manager.rs` and `storage/memory.rs` included, builds or matches the path of a well-known `.jit` file or directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each such site uses a `VirtualPath` constant, and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve`.
title: Storage and configuration code name well-known files through VirtualPath constants
